title: Why we revert to original titles
guide_zh: HN 解释为何常把投稿标题改回原题，回应编辑行为带来的疑问。
author: pg
excerpt: In the HN guidelines, we ask submitters to use original titles when possible. When they don't, we often change the title of a post back to the original title of the article. There is an ongoing trickle of complaints about this, as if we were engaged in some sort of sinister conspiracy. Titles on HN are not self-expression the way comments are. Titles are common property.
